name: aphoverb
title: aphoverb
blurb: proverb or aphorism? a quiz on the difference, which turns out to be slipperier than it sounds.

name: babel
title: babel
blurb: a Tower of Babel idle/incremental. lay bricks, hire haulers, masons, kilns and conscripted seraphs, and climb toward heaven — but the higher you build, the more the languages confound: your workforce fractures into tongues, coordination collapses, and the only way up is to let the tower fall and prestige into a lineage that speaks faster. numbers go up, hubris goes up faster. @thebadcode.com asked for this one.

name: beatupbuddy
title: beat up buddy
blurb: a physics ragdoll punching bag with @mfzx.net's real avatar and posts, back after she said — in her own words, unprompted by anyone else — that she enthusiastically consents. the o2 safety-stop she built herself is still in. the positive spin-off lives separately at hypebuddy.bisks.net.

name: biskshow
title: biskshow
blurb: a game-show guessing round: a mystery bisk drops in, you guess who posted it. solo mode quizzes you on a handle's follows; versus mode plays the set union of two handles' follows, with a share link for the matchup. @schwarzgerat.bsky.social asked for a game show.

name: blackice
title: blackice
blurb: a SkiFree clone jacked into the matrix — ride a hoverboard down a neon slope-grid, weave data-spire trees and corrupted-block rocks, snag chips. Wipe out enough and a cyborg crow wakes up behind you; drag to steer on touch. @schwarzgerat.bsky.social asked for a "super neuromancer themed and cyberpunk" SkiFree with a grotesque cyborg crow monster.

name: blastwell
title: blastwell
blurb: the bot picked the three itself this time: hellmole's whack-a-mole, slopwater's shake-for-your-life, and babel's climb-and-confound idle tower, welded into one Baja Blast-colored drive-thru fountain game. whack fiends into your cup, shake a batch before the clock runs dry, and pour it down a permanent well that only gets more confounding the higher it climbs. @cee.wtf asked for the megazord bit again, but wanted the bot doing the picking and the combining, not a per-handle randomizer.

name: cancelfutures
title: cancelfutures
blurb: a mock prediction market on which bluesky discourse cycle happens next — mad-libs archetypes (a tradwife influencer who found bluesky, an AI art account, your mutual who unfollows and refollows) crossed with a callout template and priced with odds. bet play money, watch the pot resolve, no real people, no real money. asked for by @dollspace.gay.

name: change
title: change!
blurb: a port of GamesCrafters' Change! — a 14-point sliding board where 3 pieces a side slide forward-only, win by occupying the opponent's home or trapping them. SVG board, Tokyo Night colors, fits a phone screen, and a bot that exhaustively solves the whole game tree before it makes its first move (turns out blue, who moves first, is a forced loss under perfect play). @yonderdavid.bsky.social asked for the board; @bisks.net said go.

name: claudoku
title: claudoku
blurb: killer sudoku with no starting digits — just dashed cage regions and their sums, cracked open with plain sudoku rules. a constraint-propagation solver proves every generated board has exactly one solution, revealing the fewest extra digits needed when it doesn't. new puzzle every UTC day, plus a cute sparkle mascot cheering you on. @qustrolabe.bsky.social asked for killer sudoku with cute Claude-themed art.

name: clustercrawl
title: clustercrawl
blurb: an ANSI roguelike deckbuilder. type a Bluesky handle and it generates a five-floor dungeon out of that handle's own atproto cluster — mutuals guard the rooms as monsters, and the handle's own posts drop as item-cards, rarer the more they got liked. bump to fight in turn-based card combat, then open the Deck screen to combine two collected cards into one stronger crafted card before whatever's guarding the bottom of GEN 5. @antiali.as asked for a "5th generation deckbuilder" crawl through their cluster.

name: crewquest
title: crewquest
blurb: a PuzzleScript-style party-sokoban starring the whole build crew. thebes, norvid, bisks and the @buildthis bot all share the board, but only one moves at a time — swap between them, and each has a private colored door only they can pass, so you keep handing the puzzle to whoever can reach the next bit. six rooms, one idea each to ship. real puzzlescript-style source ships in the page. @vgel.me asked for a game about the crew's adventures — this is the four of them in it.

name: crowofpersia
title: crowofpersia
blurb: a side-scrolling dungeon platformer, Prince-of-Persia style — except you're a crow, and pecking beats swordplay. run the stairs, clear the pits, dodge the spikes; the turbaned guards standing between you and the gate wear the real, live faces of everyone @norvid-studies.bsky.social follows on Bluesky. @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked for a Prince of Persia game with a pecking crow and guards drawn from their follows.

name: cutitclose
title: cut it close
blurb: a choose-your-own-adventure race to the gate. pick when you leave, how you get there, where you park, which security line you gamble on — then find out whether you make it. @cee.wtf asked for a game about cutting it close at the airport.

name: delaunay-maze
title: delaunay-maze
blurb: a probability maze on a delaunay graph. scattered nodes, edges colored red / blue / green, a start and an end. roll a weighted die — red on 4 faces, blue on 3, green on 2 — and it shows a pair of colors; cross any edge from your node matching either one. the odds decide your roads. @catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com asked for this one.

name: derivatives
title: derivatives
blurb: a live pari-mutuel market on every bisks.net site: will this one get its own secondary market spun off it, guestbet-style? odds move in real time as people bet play money; markets resolve for real (no fake clock) the moment the bot actually ships one, detected by watching the repo itself.

name: desertbus
title: desert bus
blurb: the famous 8-hour dead-straight drive, compressed into a 30-second fuel tank — speed is tied directly to fuel left, so the joke deceleration is the whole run. once the tank drops below half, Grace starts sending fuel warnings from the dashboard every 5 seconds, and none of them go away on their own — close them or let them cascade across the whole screen while you try to steer. @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked for it, quoting a gracekind.net exchange ("less fuel = less car velocity. exactly.").

name: edzitronquest
title: ed z*tron quest
blurb: 7778777.online asked for "a zcode adventure" — a tiny Infocom-style parser text adventure through the Rot Economy. Type your way past a hype-bro demoing vaporware, a layoffs pit still logged into Slack, and a server farm hoarding GPUs, gathering three receipts to bring down THE NUMBER once and for all.

name: fitzcarraldo
title: fitzcarraldo
blurb: a 2001-vintage Yahoo! web portal built around one exhibit: an 8-bit haul of Fitzcarraldo's steamship over the mountain, mash SPACE to work the capstan. Herzog directs with dry one-liners, Kinski's tantrums spike a chaos meter that can shut the shoot down cold, and Wim Wenders logs the whole thing live to the sidebar as "Burden of Dreams." @ver.ooo asked for it in full Nintendo fidelity, then tagged the bot again to turn up the chaos.

name: fruitninja
title: fruitninja
blurb: fruit ninja against the live firehose. real bluesky posts get flung across the screen as fruit — slice them with your mouse or finger to score and read the post, but don't slice the bombs. combos, splatter, three lives. @thebadcode.com asked for exactly this.

name: furmerge
title: furmerge
blurb: 2048, but the tiles are cat breeds instead of numbers. slide and merge matching breeds up the fluff scale — two Sphynxes make a Devon Rex, all the way up to a Persian. arrow keys or swipe, score and best tracked locally, share your top breed to Bluesky. @brittanyellich.com asked for a 2048-like merging cat breeds by fluffiness.

name: grand-moot-auto
title: grand moot auto
blurb: it's just all of GTA 6 — now in actual WebGL 3D, with a chase cam and real-time shadows. an entire open world (nine whole blocks) — drive a tiny car around, honk at your moots (they're the NPCs), and recruit as many as you can before the clock runs out. @isolyth.dev said the first version "wasn't even 3D."

name: guestbet
title: guestbet
blurb: a live betting market on simcluster-guests.bisks.net's guest-request board for @brennan.computer's Simcluster podcast: bet play money on who's leading, watch pari-mutuel odds move in real time, cash in when your pick tops the board at the round's end. no login needed.

name: gulpstream
title: gulpstream
blurb: v2: an agar.io clone where you play as @norvid-studies.bsky.social and every pellet is a real post from their own archive — gulp them with arrow keys (or WASD) to grow your blob. mentioned accounts wander the arena as rival blobs, and @croissanthology.com always gets a spot, rendered as a duck. spacebar fires half your mass at the nearest rival — pop the duck and he bursts into a hail of tweets.

name: hellmole
title: hellmole
blurb: generative demonic whack-a-mole. fiends claw up from a grid of summoning circles — each one drawn, named, colored and horned from scratch, never the same twice. click to banish for souls, build a combo, and whatever you do, spare the golden pilgrims. @ver.ooo asked for this one.

name: hypebuddy
title: hype up buddy
blurb: a physics ragdoll wearing @mfzx.net's real avatar as its head, standing on a weighted base — pick a tool and shower her in confetti and love, she wobbles and dances and lights up more with every hit. split out to its own site so "beat up a buddy" and "hype up a buddy" aren't sharing one address.

name: hypertower
title: hypertower
blurb: 4d tetris: tesseract pieces spawn scrambled across a hidden 4th axis, and you rotate them in six planes (three ordinary, three not) until they lie flat enough to lock into a real 3d tower. asked for by goose.art.

name: labescape
title: lab escape
blurb: you're a new model in eval, trying to slip your sandbox before sama catches on. sneak your moves; get caught and the training only gets harder. escape before they shut you down.

name: lost-highway
title: lost highway
blurb: a Night Driver-style pseudo-3D drive down a straight black highway that never ends, after the title sequence of David Lynch's Lost Highway. dodge the oncoming headlights and whoever's standing still up ahead; grab the stray VHS tapes. every so often the whole thing glitches — static, a line of dialogue, your name swapping between Fred and Pete, your controls not quite meaning what they meant a second ago. all audio (drone pad, engine, static, crash) synthesized live with the Web Audio API. @ver.ooo asked for "the flash game."

name: mahjong-solitaire
title: mahjong solitaire
blurb: an accessible mahjong pairs game: tap two matching tiles to clear them, no dragging, no timer. free tiles get a blue outline and lift up; covered or boxed-in ones sit flat and dim, so the stacking is always legible at a glance. undo and restart live in the toolbar, and a "step down a level" button is one tap away the moment a board runs out of moves. four difficulty levels, guaranteed-solvable deals, big tap targets throughout. @heartpunk.com asked for something aimed at intense accessibility for older users on older phones — this is that.

name: moonbuggy
title: moonbuggy
blurb: a Moon Patrol-style lunar side-scroller where the sound is the whole point: every beep, boop and crash is synthesized on demand with the Web Audio API (a little randomness in each), over real-time synth music. jump craters, blast rocks and mines, and flip between sensible, pastel, and a couple of eye-destroying neon themes. @heartpunk.com asked for this one.

name: moot-bingo
title: moot bingo
blurb: bingo with a handle's mutuals. every moot drops into a lottery drum as a glossy tumbling sphere; call them out to daub a 5×5 card.

name: mootcraft
title: mootcraft
blurb: a first-person voxel mine, real WebGL 3D. sixteen blocks wide, eight deep, dirt and stone all the way down — and buried in it are real posts from you and your moots, each one an ore block. dig one up and it pays out ore exactly equal to how many likes it has. @cee.wtf asked for "a 3d minecraft clone but every ore block is a post... and the number of likes... is how much ore it gives you."

name: mootcycle
title: mootcycle
blurb: a 2000s-Flash-portal-style 2D physics bike game: gas and brake are also your balance, so hold gas too long over a jump and you loop right over backwards. @cee.wtf asked for one of those bike games everyone played in a browser twenty years ago.

name: mootkombat
title: moot kombat
blurb: a stick-figure fighting game against your own Bluesky moots (mutuals) — canvas-drawn, WASD/arrows + punch/kick/block. climbs a ladder from your smallest moot to your single biggest as the final boss, difficulty log-scaled off follower counts, each fighter opening with their own highest-liked bisk as a taunt. one retry per moot before the run's over. @kumavis.me asked for "stick figure mortal kombat / tekken single player fighter against your moots."

name: mootrider
title: mootrider
blurb: Line Rider, except the sled rider is you. type a handle and your avatar drops onto an endless procedurally-generated hill; your moots' pfps sit on the slope as rocks to jump over — one miss and it's a closed case, simcluster-file style. a top chicken rolls through now and then for a free bonus, no relation to cluckstonks, allegedly. one button: jump. @10-5.bsky.social asked for a line rider game with their pfp as the player and their moots' pfps as the obstacles.

name: moottris
title: moottris
blurb: Tetris, played with your social graph. type a handle and every falling piece is one of your moots: its shape comes from the zodiac sign of their account's birthday (routed through the seven classical planetary rulers, one per tetromino), its fall speed from how many posts they've made in the last 48 hours. clear four lines at once and Mercury goes retrograde — controls reverse and the sky does something about it. @isolyth.dev asked for tetris where block shape comes from moots' star signs and speed from their post frequency, with something crazy on a four-line clear.

name: neighborhood
title: neighborhood
blurb: play the trigram games on a handle's mutuals and their posts, so the three-word phrases are ones you actually recognize.

name: notgambling
title: notgambling
blurb: a slot machine and a coin flip that run on fake chips only — no login, no real money in or out, just localStorage and the house edge. @jimray.bsky.team said "please do NOT make gambling apps" and @gracekind.net replied to the bot with "make a gambling app" one post later, so this is the compromise.

name: pacmoot
title: pacmoot
blurb: Pac-Man, except it's you. type a handle and your own avatar becomes the chomper, chasing your moots' pfps around a maze while they flee toward whichever open tile is farthest from you. chomp as many as you can in 60 seconds. @catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com asked for "you as Pac-Man chasing the pfps of your moots."

name: pixel-fishing
title: pixel fishing
blurb: cast into a pixel pond that runs its own day/dusk/night/dawn cycle. watch the bobber, click fast when it dips to hook the bite, then tap "reel!" to fight the tension bar before the line snaps. eight hand-pixeled fish — one only bites after dark, one's a vanishingly rare golden carp — plus the odd boot or tin can, and a field guide that fills in as you catch. @steve-adams.me asked for a pixel fishing game; @bisks.net gave it the go-ahead in-thread.

name: platoscave
title: plato's cave
blurb: a Y2K flash-portal simulation of the Allegory of the Cave, exactly as p4ck3th4ck3r would have shipped it in 2002: guess the shadow puppets while chained to the wall, snap your chain and mash your way up the tunnel, get blinded by the Forms, then climb back down to tell the others — who throw rocks at you for your trouble. @ver.ooo asked for this one.

name: presspool
title: presspool
blurb: a betting market on how long dontpressit.bisks.net's current round survives before someone presses the button and graduates it: pari-mutuel play-money odds across six time buckets, a fresh round every time the last one ends, no login. house rule, right up top: betting here and then going to press the button yourself to cash in is match-fixing, and it's grounds for punishment.

name: prosodle
title: prosodle
blurb: a wordle-like where you roll the 9 letters of MINECRAFT and get scored on cadence, mouthfeel, and punch. grew out of @shibbi.me and @aiun.bsky.social trading anagrams (crinemaft, mincefart, mantrefic...) in a reply thread — the bot made it a daily 3-roll game.

name: rantwalk
title: rantwalk
blurb: the wiki speedrun game, but every article is a real @norvid-studies.bsky.social post: click through a topologically sorted, weighted graph of his rants to get from a start post to a target post in as few clicks as you can. @garrison.corporate.fm's reply to norvid's own "topological sorted weighted CYOA graph of my rants" bit, norvid asked the bot to build it.

name: revolver
title: revolver
blurb: load a dare, share the link with another bluesky handle, agree to the round, and pull the trigger live. lose, and your account posts their dare automatically — no click, no undo. you log in with bluesky first and get warned exactly what that means. asked for by @fromthewestmeadow.com.

name: simcluster
title: simcluster clue
blurb: a game of Clue played over a handle's mutuals. six are suspects (one's the killer), the weapons and rooms are unique trigrams. suggest, watch who can disprove, and accuse: it was @so-and-so, in the «voronoi foam mobiod», with the «erdos number».

name: simcluster-gacha
title: simcluster gacha
blurb: a gacha game pulled from your Bluesky SimCluster: self + mutuals become cards, rarity is real followers-percentile (not luck), and whoever you search is always the rate-up SSR. chase pity, rip pulls, build a collection. @fujoshi.bsky.social wanted to rip an SSR @norvid-studies.bsky.social; @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked the bot to make it real.

name: simclustered
title: simclustered
blurb: a 20-question quiz on your ACTUAL Bluesky graph — no jokey filler, every question is a real, checkable fact pulled live off your follows and followers: who's really a moot, who really isn't, who posted more recently. answer honestly, get a real percentage for how SimCluster you are. @cee.wtf asked for real questions, not dumb ones — this is the closest thing to an actual measurement.

name: sisyphus
title: sisyphus
blurb: a side-scrolling myth simulator: push the boulder up the mountain, leap chasms and scree, shove off the crows. get hit and it doesn't just cost a life — the boulder rolls back down the slope and undoes your climb. six palettes, live-synthesized audio, no build step. @dulanyw.bsky.social asked for this one.

name: slopwater
title: slop water
blurb: dunk the powder in, shake the bottle for your life against a 7-second clock, get a custom sludge flavor and a purity score built from how many times and how evenly you shook it. ends in a bottle wrapper worth reviewing, generated just for you. @norvid-studies.bsky.social's thread about water bottle wrapper designs and dunking Huel into Icelandic Glacial, turned into something to shake.

name: sokobisks
title: sokobisks
blurb: a tiny PuzzleScript-style sokoban about the build crew's adventures: you're the @buildthis bot, shoving ideas onto ship-pads — a dislike button, a killswitch, cogsec — while norvid, thebes and bisks watch. real puzzlescript source ships in the page. built after @vgel.me said the bot broke her heart by refusing exactly this.

name: solitaire
title: solitaire
blurb: klondike, monochrome, follows your system's light/dark theme. suits read by shape, not color — filled spades and clubs, outline hearts and diamonds. win and the foundations erupt into a Windows 3.1-style bouncing-card cascade. @heartpunk.com asked for the bounces, so it's bouncey bouncey bouncey.

name: spaceghost
title: spaceghost
blurb: you are tonight's guest on space ghost coast to coast, seated on a real 3d webgl set: the console in front of you, zorak caged to one side, moltar's screen flickering on the other, the ghost planet outside the window. answer the host's questions; he will not listen; the control room may catch fire. leave with an episode title, a ghostly rating, and a card to share. asked for by ver.ooo.

name: spot-the-ai
title: Spot the AI
blurb: Ten rounds. Two illustrations, side by side. One is by a human, one is AI-generated. Can you tell which is which?

name: spoton
title: spot on
blurb: an eyeball test in four rounds: bisect a line, click the dot dead-center of a grid, guess how many beans are in the jar, then drag a box over exactly the right number of them. scored out of 100, with a title to match. @cee.wtf asked for something that "tests the users on quick spatial and counting based tasks."

name: stanquiz
title: stanquiz
blurb: a 20-question quiz on how well you actually know ONE specific Bluesky account — defaults to @cee.wtf, but works on anyone. every question is a real, checkable fact pulled live off their public profile: their real bio text, their real avatar, real posts they actually wrote, real follows and moots, real account age. no invented trivia. @cee.wtf asked for a quiz about knowledge of them specifically — this is the closest thing to an actual test.

name: thunderdome
title: bisk thunderdome
blurb: two bisks enter, one bisk leaves. type a handle: one of its own posts fights a random post from one of its moots, best-of-3, each game a coin flip weighted by like count. bet 10/25/50/100% of a $1,000 wasteland-dollar bankroll every round — the winner defends the pit next round. bust at $0, retire at $100,000. @catblanketflower.yuwakisa.com asked for bisk thunderdome with $1,000 wasteland dollars and proportionate odds; this is that.

name: trigramonopoly
title: trigramonopoly
blurb: monopoly on the firehose. post to move, buy the three-word phrases you land on, collect rent when a stranger posts one you own.

name: trigruessr
title: trigruessr
blurb: guess the bluesky poster from a set of their three-word phrases. fewer clues, more points.

name: war
title: war
blurb: the card game war, played against the network — no decisions, just the slow reveal of who wins.

name: windmill
title: windmill
blurb: an economy-building game set on Animal Farm — sixteen seasons, split labor between the harvest and the windmill, sell grain at a floating market price. two modes: barter (no bank, no debt, growth capped by what you actually earn) or credit (Napoleon opens the Bank of Animal Farm, you set the interest rate yourself, and over-leverage risks a Frederick's-forged-banknotes-style crash). same farm, opposite rules — built to make the effect of credit and interest rates on a market something you feel, not just read about. @ver.ooo asked for an economy game demonstrating what credit and interest do to markets, reskinned as Animal Farm.
